mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation, measured by CPIAUCSL exceeding 220, indicates a need for aggressive monetary tightening which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE > 8.0%) signal a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600 thousand units signals a weakening in the residential construction sector, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 600, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate a monetary policy tightening cycle amid high inflation, which raises real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 10.0% signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
